purpose: Source-discovery gate (BLOCKING) before any tire record generation. Ranks sources by safety, legality, bulk feasibility, barcode coverage, and cost against the $30 cash cap.

sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Best possible source: real, owned, has scannable codes. NOT PROVIDED this run. Drop a CSV into data/tire-catalog/ to unblock bulk stages.
sources.notes: The pipeline (src/services/tire) is built to ingest this immediately.

sources.source_name: Vendor / distributor CSV or price sheet
sources.cost_estimate: $0 if owner has a vendor relationship
sources.terms_or_robots_risk: low (B2B data the owner is licensed to use)
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Clean bulk source with scannable codes. NOT PROVIDED this run.

sources.estimated_records_available: ~240,000 tires (440 makes, 13,000 models), indexed by Mfr Product Code, UPC, EAN, GTIN
sources.cost_estimate: commercial license (price not public; likely > $30 and a licensing decision)
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: This is the RIGHT bulk source to reach 5000 with scannable barcodes, but it is a paid license / owner purchasing decision, almost certainly over the $30 cap. Recommend to the owner.

sources.cost_estimate: paid product (subscription, free updates 1st year) - price likely near/over $30
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Buyable bulk CSV with codes; depends on price vs $30 cap and license. Owner decision.
General barcode DB, not tire-curated; per-code, costs against the $30 cap.

sources.cost_estimate: $0 on free tier (overage billed); REQUIRES a registered API key (owner signup)
sources.terms_or_robots_risk: license permits use for own operations; rate-limited
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Genuinely free and terms-permitting for VERIFYING a small sample of tire UPCs, but (1) needs an API key the owner hasn't provided, (2) 40 searches/day can't build 500/5000, (3) tire coverage is uneven. Verification-only.

sources.cost_estimate: $74.95/mo min (5,000 lookups) - OVER the $30 cap; one-by-one
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Cheapest plan exceeds the $30 cap and is one-by-one. Owner bulk_source_rule forbids one-by-one paid to reach 500/5000.

sources.terms_or_robots_risk: anti-bot (returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch); ToS restricts scraping
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Paid one-by-one; site actively blocks automated access. Not viable for bulk within cap.

sources.estimated_records_available: company-prefix / GTIN verification (not a tire catalog)
sources.cost_estimate: $0 for single lookups; bulk requires membership
sources.terms_or_robots_risk: ToS restricts automated/bulk querying; some endpoints login-gated
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Authoritative for verifying a GTIN's brand owner, but not a bulk tire source and bulk automation is restricted.

sources.source_name: Manufacturer catalog / spec pages (Michelin, Goodyear, etc.)
sources.estimated_records_available: thousands of models (specs), but barcodes rarely published
sources.terms_or_robots_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH: many manufacturer/retailer ToS prohibit automated extraction even where robots allows crawl; verify robots.txt per domain and extract FACTUAL fields only.
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: Good for FACTUAL specs (size/load/speed are non-copyrightable facts) with source URLs, but does NOT reliably yield scannable UPC/GTIN. Use only on robots-permitted pages, facts-only, capped, for SPEC candidates - never as a barcode source.
sources.notes: Yields spec-only candidates, not verified-scannable records.

sources.source_name: Retailer pages (Tire Rack, Discount Tire, SimpleTire, Amazon)
sources.terms_or_robots_risk: HIGH: ToS prohibit scraping; sites return 403 / anti-bot; Amazon ASIN != UPC.
sources.notes: Confirmed 403/anti-bot on automated fetch this run.

sources.estimated_records_available: grows as the shop scans (0 today)
sources.reason_for_use_or_avoid: The strongest long-term source (real codes confirmed at the counter), but 0 records exist yet. Becomes the primary source once the shop scans live.
sources.notes: field_scan + human approval already wired in the app.

go_no_go.stage_100: CONDITIONAL GO (spec/SKU candidates only): build the tire pipeline + a SMALL legal candidate sample from FACTUAL manufacturer/public specs via Firecrawl (robots-permitted, facts-only, capped). Verified-scannable barcode coverage will be LOW because no free source reliably publishes tire UPC/GTIN.
go_no_go.stage_500: NO-GO: no safe free/bulk source of scannable tire barcodes. One-by-one paid APIs (Go-UPC $74.95/mo, Barcode Lookup) exceed the $30 cap and are forbidden for bulk by the owner's bulk_source_rule. STOP before spending.
go_no_go.stage_5000: NO-GO: same blocker as 500; reaching 5000 scannable records requires a paid/licensed bulk tire database (Tireweb ~240k, TiresAddict) or an owner/vendor CSV - an owner purchasing/file decision, not feasible within $30 / no-files this run.
go_no_go.decision: Complete source discovery + build the pipeline + run a bounded, honest 100-stage candidate sample, then STOP before 500/5000 with this cost/source blocker. Do not pad. Do not exceed $30. Do not bypass ToS/robots.
